title: BLF: Implement a mechanism for linear read
description: This unfortunately can't be easily decoupled from !13349, so I included the commits here.

notes.body:
added 13 commits
  • 9c923f82...2b181766 - 9 commits from branch wireshark:master
  • f6d51b46 - BLF: Remove almost all file_seek instances in preparation for linear file read
  • 59213eec - BLF: Prepare for sequential log container read
  • 160c9bf9 - BLF: Implement linear read
  • 360da8f0 - BLF: Add support for pipe input
[Compare with previous version](/wireshark/wireshark/-/merge_requests/13399/diffs?diff_id=853610075&start_sha=9c923f828d4460555805aaabaeb206a6c1ef11fd)
g_array_binary_search was added in Glib 2.61.2, we however support Glib 2.54 and forward
And unfortunately RHEL8 and clones are on 2.56 so it's difficult to bump the minimum requirement for 4.4.x

Hi,
I have not looken at the code but we could put  g_array... code in
ws_compat or whatever it was called. To be used on older systems.
Best regards
Anders



skrev:
Yes, putting it in the `glib-compat` in wsutil seems pretty easy, the source for the function is straightforward and short.
